title.zh-CN: 孕晚期心脏筛查异常 · 26岁孕妇
title.en: An abnormal late-pregnancy cardiac screen · 26-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 四腔心外观正常的胎儿仍出现大血管疑点，需制定产前沟通及出生后评估计划。
summary.en: A fetal great-vessel concern despite a normal four-chamber view prompts antenatal counselling and postnatal planning.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别血管环的多切面证据。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise multi-view evidence of a vascular ring.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分四腔心正常与完整心血管评估。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish a normal four-chamber view from a complete cardiac assessment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制定出生后解剖确认及气道观察计划。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan postnatal anatomical confirmation and airway observation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 准确表达遗传检查未完成的含义。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain what an uncompleted genetic investigation means.

text.zh-CN: 胎儿生长、羊水及胎盘位置报告正常；四腔心和流出道外观、位置与对称性正常。
text.en: Growth, fluid and placental location were reported normal; cardiac situs, four-chamber appearance and outflow tracts appeared normal.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 右侧主动脉弓、左侧动脉导管，气管左侧另有对称结构围成完整血管环，呈“9”字；两侧锁骨下动脉分别来自同侧弓。
text.en: A right aortic arch and left ductus with another arch-like structure left of the trachea formed a complete ring and “9” configuration; each subclavian artery arose from its respective arch.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

name.zh-CN: 调阅气管及多普勒记录

zh-CN: 调阅气管及多普勒记录

text.zh-CN: 气管穿过血管环并有压迹；双弓未见血流梗阻。因胎动和靶结构小，产前不能可靠区分优势弓。
text.en: The trachea crossed the ring with an indentation; neither arch showed flow obstruction. Fetal movement and small structures prevented reliable prenatal identification of the dominant arch.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 因可能相关的染色体异常，包括 22q11.2 微缺失，曾建议羊水检查；夫妇拒绝，故无该项确证结果。
text.en: Amniocentesis was offered for potentially associated chromosomal abnormalities including 22q11.2 deletion; the couple declined, so no confirmation is available.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 孕 39 周剖宫产男婴 3120 g，5 分钟 Apgar 10 分；出生后需高流量呼吸支持，CTA 确认右弓优势及气管受压。哭闹或喂养后咳嗽并偶有喘鸣，生后 18 天切断左弓；6 月龄无呼吸困难、发绀或喉鸣，生长发育报告正常。
text.en: At 39 weeks a 3120 g boy was delivered by caesarean, with a five-minute Apgar of 10. He required high-flow support; CTA confirmed right dominance and tracheal compression. Cough after crying/feeding and occasional wheeze preceded left-arch division at 18 days. At six months no dyspnoea, cyanosis or stridor was reported and development was described as normal.

text.zh-CN: 双主动脉弓形成完整血管环
text.en: A double aortic arch forming a complete vascular ring

feedback.zh-CN: 两弓、同侧分支和环绕气管共同支持。
feedback.en: Two arches, their branches and complete encirclement support this.

text.zh-CN: 正常四腔心已排除大血管异常
text.en: The normal four-chamber view excludes great-vessel anomalies

feedback.zh-CN: 大血管切面提供四腔心以外的信息。
feedback.en: Great-vessel views provide information beyond the four chambers.

text.zh-CN: 仅有单一右弓，不存在完整环
text.en: A single right arch without a complete ring

feedback.zh-CN: 左侧弓和分支证据不支持这种解释。
feedback.en: The left arch and its branch evidence contradict it.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何安排产前沟通和出生后照护？
prompt.en: How should antenatal and postnatal care be planned?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 产前、儿科心脏及气道团队共同规划出生后确认与症状观察
text.en: Antenatal, paediatric cardiac and airway teams plan postnatal confirmation and observation

feedback.zh-CN: 产前图像提示气道受压，需要跨团队衔接。
feedback.en: Prenatal compression findings justify coordinated postnatal planning.

text.zh-CN: 因血流通畅而无需出生后评估
text.en: No postnatal assessment because arch flow is patent

feedback.zh-CN: 通畅血流不排除气管受压。
feedback.en: Patent arch flow does not exclude airway compression.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭本例规定所有患儿同一天手术
text.en: Set one operation day for every infant from this case

feedback.zh-CN: 手术时点取决于个体症状与解剖。
feedback.en: Timing depends on individual symptoms and anatomy.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些诊断仍不可直接宣告？
prompt.en: Which conclusions cannot yet be asserted?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 优势弓及染色体状态需保留未知
text.en: Dominant arch and chromosomal status remain unresolved

feedback.zh-CN: 产前未能区分优势弓，且羊水检查未做。
feedback.en: Dominance was unresolved prenatally and amniocentesis was declined.

text.zh-CN: 已确诊 22q11.2 微缺失
text.en: 22q11.2 deletion is confirmed

feedback.zh-CN: 关联风险不等于检测结果。
feedback.en: An association is not a test result.

text.zh-CN: 左侧弓一定占优势
text.en: The left arch is definitely dominant

feedback.en: Prenatal data do not establish this.

text.en: Clarify the presenting problem

text.zh-CN: 问清起病时间
text.en: Clarify onset

text.zh-CN: 询问病情演变
text.en: Clarify progression

text.zh-CN: 询问伴随症状
text.en: Clarify associated symptoms

text.zh-CN: 调阅关键记录后再决策
text.en: Review key records before deciding

text.zh-CN: 选择证据最支持的解释
text.en: Choose the interpretation best supported by the evidence

text.zh-CN: 不以正常四腔心或正常血流排除气道风险
text.en: Do not exclude airway risk from a normal four-chamber view or patent flow

text.zh-CN: 核对原报告结局并保留未知
text.en: Review the reported outcome without filling gaps

text.zh-CN: 首次选择符合证据的处理路径
text.en: Choose an evidence-consistent plan on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 解释证据与不确定性，核对患者或陪同者理解
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty and check patient or companion understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 胎儿双主动脉弓在孕晚期识别，出生后确认右优势并接受左弓切断，6 月龄症状改善。
conclusion.en: Double aortic arch was detected late in pregnancy; right dominance was confirmed after birth and left-arch division was followed by favourable six-month symptoms.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 四腔心、大血管和三血管气管切面互补（ISUOG 2023）。
keyReasoning.en: Four-chamber, great-vessel and three-vessel-trachea views are complementary (ISUOG 2023).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 优势弓判断的不确定性应明确交接。
keyReasoning.en: Explicitly hand over uncertainty about arch dominance.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 拒绝检查后的状态是未知，不是阴性。
keyReasoning.en: A declined test leaves uncertainty, not a negative result.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
